Messages.Author: mugwump242
Messages.Body:
Given that a vampire must tap to vote if this card is played. Does it
therefore follow that tapped vampires cannot vote? Given that they
cannot meet the required criteria..

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You mistate the effect.
It isn't "tap to vote", it's "when a vampire votes, tap him".
When a tapped vampire votes, tap him.
When an untapped vampire votes, tap him.
